field_rules: Carry real navigation/emergency tools; sky features are orientation/planning aids only.
Pre-download or precompute exact Sun/Moon/planet data before hikes where timing matters.
If network is unavailable, use cached/precomputed summaries and conservative turnaround/headlamp timing.
Weather/cloud cover overrides astronomy planning; check NOAA/NWS cache when online.
